svg.title: A lightbulb with a filament and a screw base — no giant glow halo.
svg.desc: An idea bulb: glass envelope, a thick filament, three-ridge screw base. Ideas, energy, inventions — use it only when the idea is literally 'a light went on'. Glass paper, filament accent, base ink, a small highlight accent2. There is no radiating glow disc; that read as a planet at stamp size.
